svg.title: Side-by-side comparison: OpenAlgo symtoken vs AION active retention architecture
svg.desc: Two columns showing how OpenAlgo stores only the active broker master (no broker column) versus AION's multi-broker table with active retention, canonical keys, and instant switching.

g.text: no broker column — one broker at a time

svg.text: No broker column → no parallel lookup

g.text: broker column — all brokers cached locally

svg.text: Switch is instant — all mappings pre-cached
Cross-broker validation in a single query
Agent stays under 50 MB — fully offline
